resumeText:
Meera Krishnan | Bengaluru, Karnataka | meera.krishnan.law@example.com

EDUCATION
BA LLB (Hons), Deccan National Law School, Bengaluru (2021 - 2026) | CGPA 6.9/8

INTERNSHIPS
Intern, Technology and Data Practice, Lalbagh Legal Partners, Bengaluru (May 2025 - Jun 2025, 6 weeks)
- Summarised the obligations of data fiduciaries under the DPDP Act, 2023 into a two-page client note.
- Helped draft a records of processing activities (RoPA) template for a fintech client's customer data.
- Reviewed 15 vendor contracts for data processing and security clauses and listed gaps in a tracker.

Intern, Cyber Law Cell, Karnataka Legal Aid Clinic, Bengaluru (Dec 2024 - Jan 2025, 6 weeks)
- Prepared research notes on consumer complaints about loan app data misuse.

PROJECTS AND RESEARCH
- Seminar paper: Consent and notice requirements under the DPDP Act compared with GDPR (25 pages).
- Moot court: Researched and argued the respondent side in an inter-college moot on the right to privacy.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Constitutional Law, Contract Law, Information Technology Law, Law of Torts
- Certificate course in Data Protection and Privacy Law (online, 2025)

SKILLS
DPDP Act, GDPR basics, Privacy notices, Contract review, Breach notification, Legal research, MS Word

ACTIVITIES
- Presented a seminar on DPDP Act consent rules to 60 students at the law school's tech law society
- Editorial board, student law review
